data.name: ENDPUNK
data.detailed_description:
It all happened so fast, and everything changed... When the war broke out, tactical nukes were used on the front lines. But that was not enough. The silos opened, and hundreds of warheads rained down on the surface. In the chaos that followed, desperate forces unleashed biological weapons, spreading disease and horror across what remained...

Will you board the last chopper into the ruins as an Immortal or a Necrotic?

ENDPUNK is a voxel-style post-apocalyptic survival game where every raid into the ruins is a fight for survival and progress. You play as a hardened scavenger dropped deep into a devastated cityscape, searching for medicine, supplies, and gear among the wreckage. Each mission is a tense descent into hostile territory, filled with mutants, rival looters, and environmental hazards.

Loot and upgrade: Scavenge weapons, armor, and rare items to improve your loadout. Every successful run expands your arsenal and unlocks new tactical options.

Progression through survival: The more you loot, the stronger you become. Customize your character’s gear and abilities to adapt to increasingly dangerous zones.

Dynamic combat: Engage in fast-paced voxel gunfights using a variety of firearms and improvised weapons. Enemies react to sound, movement, and aggression.

Atmospheric ruins: Explore urban wastelands filled with crumbling buildings, burning vehicles, and hidden caches. Brave the ruins solo, team up with friends in co-op raids, or jump into fast-paced team deathmatch battles to prove your skills.

ENDPUNK blends gritty survival mechanics with stylized voxel visuals, delivering a brutal and rewarding scavenging experience. Every upgrade is a step closer to mastering the ruins.

data.short_description: ENDPUNK is a post-apocalyptic online shooter where you fight through nuclear ruins as an Immortal or a Necrotic. Scavenge supplies, upgrade your gear, and survive hostile zones. Jump into team FPS deathmatch to prove your strength.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Dual‑core CPU (Intel or AMD)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 or better / OpenGL
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with OpenAL

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains frequent combat and shooting in a stylized voxel environment. Enemies can be defeated with firearms, but there is no realistic gore, no dismemberment, and no graphic depictions of injury. The game does not include sexual content, nudity, drug use, or other adult themes.
